static string DescribeRoundRobin()
    {
        return "Performs a round-robin cycle on a Queue<string> by calling "
             + "Dequeue to remove the front element in O(1) amortized time, "
             + "appending it to the log list, then re-inserting it at the back "
             + "with Enqueue in O(1) amortized time. The loop runs for at most "
             + "'rounds' iterations, stopping early if the queue becomes empty. "
             + "Queue<string> uses a circular internal array buffer that is "
             + "resized when full. The queue size remains unchanged after the "
             + "method returns because each Dequeue is paired with an Enqueue. "
             + "Dequeue throws InvalidOperationException on an empty queue but "
             + "the Count guard prevents this.";
    }

static string DescribeGroupByInitial()

static string DescribeWeightedAvgPairs()
    {
        return "Pairs elements from values and weights using LINQ Zip, which "

             + "by the sum of the first (index+1) weights via Take and Sum. "
             + "Zip uses deferred execution and does not throw on mismatched "

    }

static string DescribeSumMiddleThird()
    {
        return "Computes the sum of the middle third of a ReadOnlySpan<int> by "
             + "using integer division to find start and end indices, then calling "
             + "Slice to create a narrower view into the same contiguous memory "
             + "without any heap allocation or copying. The foreach loop over the "
             + "slice is bounds-checked by the JIT. ReadOnlySpan is a ref struct "
             + "that lives only on the stack and cannot be boxed, stored in fields, "
             + "or captured by async methods. Slice throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException "
             + "if the range exceeds the span bounds. The work is O(k) for k "
             + "elements in the middle third.";
    }
